newsitem.title: USA: VLSI sees Q2 revs up from Q1.
newsitem.headline: VLSI sees Q2 revs up from Q1.

text.p: VLSI Technology Inc Thursday reiterated it expects revenues in the second quarter will increase modestly from first quarter levels with profit margins continuing to expand as its product mix improves.
"Revenue growth -- driven by our focus businesses -- is expected to accelerate in the second half of the year with revenues for the year up about 10 percent over 1996," the company added.
As reported VLSI posted net income for the first quarter reached $9.0 million, or $0.19 a share, compared to net income of $3.2 million, or $0.07 per share a year ago.
